item.title: City of Valdosta welcomes Walmart Dairy Facility
item.description: VALDOSTA - The new Walmart Dairy Facility in Valdosta will invest a total of $350 million in state-of-the-art dairy processing plant. The post City of Valdosta welcomes Walmart Dairy Facility appeared first on Valdosta Today.
